title: Guideline Sugars intake for adults and children
doc_summary:
Here are 7 concise bullet points on recommendations and behaviour-change measures:
* Reduce daily intake of free sugars to less than 10% of total energy intake
* Limit daily intake of free sugars to less than 5% of total energy intake for additional health benefits
* Restrict sugary drinks and foods high in free sugars
* Promote healthy eating habits and balanced diets
* Limit sugary snacks and desserts
* Encourage reading of food labels to identify added sugars
* Support public health interventions to decrease intake of free sugars and prevent unhealthy weight gain and dental caries
